# offline replay

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:modeOfflineReplay`](gmeow-modeOfflineReplay.md)

Offline rumination over logged or retrieved context, decoupled from live input — batch reprocessing, experience replay, memory consolidation runs. The machine analogue of human [`gmeow:modeDreaming`](gmeow-modeDreaming.md) (by analogy, NOT equivalence): endogenous reprocessing not driven by present perception.
